import os
base='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace'
os.makedirs(base+'/programs',exist_ok=True)
p=base+'/programs/task-800b2cab.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the rectangular 1-color outline and fill its interior with 4.
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if grid[r][c] != 1:
                out[r][c]=4
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
grid=[[8]*15 for _ in range(21)]
for r in range(16): grid[r][10]=1
for r, vals in [(16,range(9,14)),(17,[9,13,14]),(18,[9,13]),(19,range(9,14)),(20,[10])]:
 for c in vals:grid[r][c]=1
exec(compile(code,p,'exec'),globals())
out=transform(grid)
print(out)
